name: Altuzarra
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $845 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's dresses, skirts, tailoring and knitwear, dresses around $2,000, sold through its own Madison Avenue store, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2008 by Joseph Altuzarra.

ownership.owner: Altuzarra, LLC (private; P180 holds a minority stake since 2024; Kering held a minority stake 2013–2020)

quote.q: My mission is to design a modern wardrobe for women to feel confident and sexy in their everyday lives.
quote.who: Joseph Altuzarra, founder and creative director

opview: “My mission is to design a modern wardrobe for women to feel confident and sexy in their everyday lives.” — Joseph Altuzarra, founder and creative director, About, altuzarra.com

facts_read.source: brand site; brand terms; WWD Japan (from US WWD) 2026-04-14; neimanmarcus.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Altuzarra women's ready-to-wear; EXCLUDED: pieces whose description says 'featured on the runway' (27), bags, belts, scarves, jewellery

doors.note: 2 flagships listed. Page publishes no ZIPs (ZIP = NC); Madison state derived from 'NEW YORK'. Separate /pages/stockists exists for wholesale (not counted).

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 10 product types, proportional; 249 styles from 300 listings in /collections/ready-to-wear/products.json

craft_evidence.mills: no on PDPs ('Viscose Lenzing' on one knit is a fibre producer, not a mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 69% (55 of 80 sampled: Italy 42, Turkey 9, Portugal 3, Japan 1; most knitwear states none)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed — 'launched by Joseph Altuzarra in 2008'
craft_evidence.process: no — 'anchored in artisanal craftsmanship', no process published
craft_evidence.reasoning: Most woven pieces state a country (Italy, with leathers from Turkey), but knitwear mostly does not, and nothing names a factory, maker or mill. The about page claims artisanal craftsmanship without saying where, so this is a 2.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 1 (2026-10-14): no named fabric. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
